rules_satisfied: no unchecked indexing or unchecked arithmetic
no lossy as conversions (checked_div used for average)
core logic isolated from I/O/rendering (render_summary is separate pure function)
typed errors used for all failure modes (Empty, Invalid, TooMany, Overflow)
overflow detection via checked_add on total accumulation
division by zero guarded via checked_div fallback
parse errors mapped to SummaryError::Invalid instead of unwrap
cargo fmt clean, no formatting issues
residual_risk: checked_div returns 0 for zero-divisor; count=0 case returns empty input error before division, so division by zero is unreachable in practice. No external dependencies, no FFI, no unsafe, no concurrency.
